how_its_made: We used Superfluid's ERC-777 standard to open payment channels from NFTs using Zora's Framework to mint NFTs on IPFS to document achievements while integrating with Ceramic's DID for a comprehensive solution with self-sovereign identity. We are aiming to ultimately integrate self-sovereign identity with DeFi with platforms such as BadgerDAO, Yearn.Finance, etc.
